q-5870.name: Question 1
q-5870.worked_solution:
Recall that

- a function is even if $f(-x)=f(x)$ for all $x$ in the domain of $f$

- a function is odd if $f(-x)=-f(x)$ for all $x$ in the domain of $f$

For our function, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(-6) & =85=-f(6), \\ f(-4) & =75=-f(4), \\ f(-2) & =30=-f(2).\end{aligned}
$$

This means that $f(-x)=-f(x)$ for all $x$ in the domain of the function. Therefore, $f(x)$ is an odd function.

q-72132.name: Question 2
q-72132.problem: Is the function $f(x)={x}^{3}+8x$ even, odd, or neither?
q-72132.worked_solution:
Recall that

- a function is even if $f(-x)=f(x)$ for all $x$

- a function is odd if $f(-x)=-f(x)$ for all $x$

Computing $f(-x)$ for the given function and comparing it to $f(x),$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(-x) & =(-x)^{3}+8(-x) \\  & =-{x}^{3}-8x.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $f(-x)\ne f(x),$ the function is not even.

Lastly, we compute $-f(x)$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}-f(x) & =-({x}^{3}+8x) \\  & =-{x}^{3}-8x.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $f(-x)=-f(x),$ the function is odd.

Computing f(−x) for the given function and comparing it to f(x), we have

f(−x)=(−x)3+8(−x)=−x3−8x.

Since f(−x)≠f(x), the function is not even.

Lastly, we compute −f(x) and get −f(x)=−(x3+8x)=−x3−8x.

Since f(−x)=−f(x), the function is odd.

q-110654.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14246337/assets/58e4554f6e5081ec5db6876222a7eeea24135743e4b68e25204084e097066ea4.png)

Which of the above could be graphs of odd functions?
q-110654.worked_solution:
Recall that the graph of an odd function must have rotational symmetry of order $2$ about the origin.

- Graphs II, III, and IV do not have rotational symmetry of order $2$ about the origin. So, it is **not** an odd function.

- On the other hand, graph I does have rotational symmetry about the origin. If we rotate the graph ${180}^{∘}$ around the origin, we get the same picture. This means that graph  I  show odd functions.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14246337/assets/3b5e234a3416a5e7100468b81f170171a873508eb0c87bba126009daca9e49bc.png)

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only."
